sentences.text: At the April 2026 AGM, ASML shareholders were notified of the reappointment of Roger Dassen as CFO and Frederic Schneider-Maunoury as COO and the appointment of Marco Pieters to the Board of Management, with Pieters having taken the CTO role immediately in October 2025 and his board seat expanding the Board of Management from five to six members.
Supervisory Board member Alexander Everke's term ended, Benjamin Loh joined, and the terms of Nils Andersen and Jack de Kreij end at the 2027 AGM.
